Supports plain-language clause interpretation, document parsing, gap analysis, one-click document generation, mock-audit Q&A, and automatic conversion of legacy documents into standard-compliant formats.
skills.description_zh:
条款解读→解析→差距→生成→转换→模拟审核→交付，支持ISO9001/14001/45001/27001/20000… 
① 差距分析：丢一份公司制度进去，自动说清缺哪几条程序、哪几条是高压线，还附可一键生成的文件清单
